newsitem.title: FRANCE: French inflation drop due to fall in car prices.
newsitem.headline: French inflation drop due to fall in car prices.

text.p: A fall in French consumer prices in November was largely caused by a drop in car prices due to sales promotions, national statistics institute INSEE said on Wednesday.
INSEE said earlier that consumer prices fell between 0.1 and 0.2 percent in November, giving a year-on-year rise of between 1.5 and 1.6 percent.

Prices of manufactured goods, which make up 33 percent of the index, fell 0.6 percent. Making up this fall was a 0.1 percent drop in prices of clothes and shoes and a 0.7 percent fall in prices of other manufactured goods.
INSEE said the fall in manufactured goods prices was due mainly to a reduction in car prices due to sales promotions.
Car sales have slumped since a government car sales incentive scheme ended in September.
An INSEE economist said the drop in car prices was the main reason behind the November monthly inflation fall.
